entities.name: De-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by UE or network to deregister for 5GS services over 3GPP access, non-3GPP access, or both. Can be initiated by UE or network under various conditions.

entities.name: UE-initiated de-registration
entities.description: De-registration procedure initiated by the UE under conditions such as switch off, eCall inactivity, USIM removal, or when needing to deregister specific access types.

entities.name: Network-initiated de-registration
entities.description: De-registration procedure initiated by the network to inform UE about deregistration or to request re-registration.

entities.name: De-registration type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of de-registration, such as 'switch off' when triggered by USIM removal.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to UE during network-initiated de-registration procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer that can be running while UE initiates de-registration procedure.

entities.name: Non-3GPP de-registration timer
entities.description: Timer provided by AMF to UE for non-3GPP de-registration.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State entered by AMF for 3GPP access during de-registration procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE
entities.description: State where UE is considered idle by AMF.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: State where UE is connected to the network.

entities.name: Switch off condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is switched off, triggering UE-initiated de-registration.

entities.name: USIM removal condition
entities.description: Condition where USIM is removed from UE, triggering de-registration with 'switch off' type.

entities.name: Emergency PDU session condition
entities.description: Condition where UE has emergency PDU session, affecting network-initiated de-registration.

entities.name: UE radio capability deletion
entities.description: Property where AMF deletes stored UE radio capability information when entering 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.

relations.description: UE-initiated de-registration is a variant of the general de-registration procedure.
Network-initiated de-registration is a variant of the general de-registration procedure.
Network-initiated de-registration procedure involves sending DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.
De-registration type IE indicates 'switch off' when triggered by USIM removal condition.
Switch off condition requires UE to initiate de-registration procedure.
USIM removal condition requires UE to initiate de-registration procedure.
Emergency PDU session condition prevents AMF from sending DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.
Entering 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state establishes the property of UE radio capability deletion.
UE-initiated de-registration can be started even when timer T3346 is running.
AMF provides non-3GPP de-registration timer during network-initiated de-registration.
When UE is in 5GMM-IDLE state, AMF locally deregisters UE without sending DEREGISTRATION REQUEST.
When UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED state, AMF initiates network-initiated de-registration procedure.
